findings.title: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets `end` to the start of `day` and then adds one day, so `endOfDay(day)` returns the start of the next day at 00:00:00, not the end of the current day at 23:59:59.999. This breaks the function's documented intent and any code that relies on the old behavior, such as `rangeEnd` in `src/range.ts`.

summary.problem: The refactor of `endOfDay` changes its return value to the start of the next day, breaking its contract and downstream usage.
summary.done_well: The change is minimal and uses an existing helper (`startOfDay`) to avoid duplication.
